english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a computer or system becoming unresponsive.

exampleSentences.english: The computer has gone into a hang and isn't responding.
exampleSentences.traditional: 部電腦死機喇，撳乜都冇反應。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 din6 nou5 sei2 gei1 laa3 gam6 mat1 dou1 mou5 faan2 jing3

english.note: Use this for a computer or device crash that leaves it frozen or unusable.

exampleSentences.english: The computer suddenly had a crash.
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 din6 nou5 dat6 jin4 sei2 gei1 laa3
